primary_title: ATM phosphorylates histone H2AX in response to DNA double-strand breaks
decision_basis: Primary ATM kinase and H2AX Ser139/gamma-H2AX evidence supports exact ATM-H2AX damage-signaling edge.
limitations_preserved: Preserve ATM-major-kinase, DNA-PK/ATR contribution, mammalian damage model and no SCI/terminal-TF boundaries.

primary_title: Requirement of ATM in phosphorylation of the human p53 protein at serine 15 following DNA double-strand breaks
decision_basis: Primary human fibroblast ATM-deficiency and pSer15 evidence supports bounded ATM-TP53 phosphorylation after double-strand breaks.
limitations_preserved: Preserve human TP53 Ser15, fibroblast and double-strand-break context; no SCI/terminal-TF boundaries.

primary_title: Ataxia-telangiectasia-mutated phosphorylates Chk2 in vivo and in vitro
decision_basis: Primary ATM immunoprecipitate, recombinant Chk2 and irradiated-cell assays support ATM-CHEK2 Thr68 phosphorylation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve CHEK2 Thr68, ionizing-radiation dependence and alternative-kinase boundaries; no SCI/terminal-TF boundaries.

primary_title: Chk2/hCds1 functions as a DNA damage checkpoint in G(1) by stabilizing p53
decision_basis: Primary recombinant and fibroblast assays support CHEK2-dependent TP53 Ser20 phosphorylation and stabilization.
limitations_preserved: Preserve TP53 Ser20, tetrameric-substrate and damage-context semantics; no SCI/terminal-TF boundaries.

primary_title: Mdm2 association with p53 targets its ubiquitination
decision_basis: Primary cell assays support MDM2-p53 association, ubiquitination and turnover.
limitations_preserved: Preserve MDM2-p53 association, stress-dependent context and ubiquitination/turnover semantics; no SCI/terminal-TF boundaries.

primary_title: Active role for nibrin in the kinetics of ATM activation
decision_basis: Primary NBS1 transgene and irradiation assays support NBN/NBS1 association with ATM in MRN-dependent activation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve NBN/NBS1 ATM-binding-domain, MRN and irradiation context; no SCI/terminal-TF boundaries.

primary_title: Phosphorylation of SMC1 is a critical downstream event in the ATM-NBS1-BRCA1 pathway
decision_basis: Primary ATM/NBS1/BRCA1 perturbation and pSMC1 checkpoint assays support ATM-SMC1 damage-response function.
limitations_preserved: Preserve NBS1/BRCA1 adaptor context and checkpoint-functional association; no SCI/terminal-TF boundaries.
